title: Fourier coefficients under input negation
statement: Let $P$ be a Boolean predicate on $n$ sign-valued inputs, let $\sigma$ specify a choice of whether to negate each input, and let $S$ be a subset of the input coordinates. The Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the indicator of the predicate after these input negations equals the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the original predicate's indicator, multiplied by $\prod_{i\in S}(-1)$ over coordinates where $\sigma_i$ prescribes negation and by $1$ over the other coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a Boolean predicate with finite arity $n$
$\sigma$ assigns a Boolean negation choice to each of the $n$ inputs
$S$ is a subset of the $n$ input coordinates
